description: Road Deaths Australia monthly bulletins (current and archived) is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group and published by Road Safety Data Hub and Analytics. Members: Archived Road Deaths Australia, Monthly Bulletins; Road Deaths Australia, Monthly Bulletins. Example entry: Archived summaries of road crash deaths and fatal road crashes are presented here. Data are sourced from the road traffic or police authorities in each jurisdiction. Data are preliminary and subject to revision. For the latest bulletin, refer to Road Deaths Australia, Monthly Bulletins. Older issues of Road Deaths Australia (2024 and prior) are available on the BITRE website. Coverage is Australia, 2019 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as archived and current, and the entry was last changed on 2026-09-10. Files and pages listed: PDF, XLSX (21 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support road incident and emergency response analysis and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
